en.headline: Hang Seng closes 150 points lower, ending a two-day rise
en.dek: The index finished at 24,130, down 0.62 per cent, after touching 24,071. The property sub-index rose 1 per cent.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed lower on Wednesday, ending two sessions of gains. Hang Seng Indexes Company put the close at 24,130.50, down 150.06 points, or 0.62 per cent, from Tuesday's 24,280.56.

The index opened lower, briefly recovered toward 24,266.92, then fell to a session low of 24,071.41 before settling. The property classification index rose 184.45 points, or 1 per cent, to 18,660.58, while the finance classification index fell 0.59 per cent.
Wednesday's midday close had already been 128 points lower at 24,151. The afternoon session added a further decline, leaving the benchmark below the level seen at lunch.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌150點 結束連升兩日
zh.dek: 恒指收報24130點，跌0.62%，盤中低見24071點。地產分類指數則升1%。
body: 港股周三回吐，結束連升兩日。恒生指數公司數據顯示，恒指收報24130.50點，跌150.06點，跌幅0.62%，上日收市為24280.56點。
指數低開後曾回升至24266.92點，其後回落，全日低見24071.41點。地產分類指數升184.45點，或1%，報18660.58點；金融分類指數則跌0.59%。
半日收市已報24151點，跌128點。午後跌幅擴大，收市低於午市水平。
